# acecloud_floating_ip_association (Resource)

Associates a floating IP address with an instance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `floating_ip_address` (String) The floating IP address to associate.
- `instance_id` (String) ID of the instance to associate the floating IP with.

### Optional

- `fixed_ip_address` (String) Fixed IP address on the instance to associate with (optional).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the association (floating_ip/instance_id).
